stops.name: Chasseral peak
stops.quote: The Chasseral peak rises to a height of 1,606 metres and offers breathtaking 360° panoramic views.
stops.english: The Chasseral peak rises to a height of 1,606 metres and offers breathtaking 360° panoramic views.

stops.name: antenna of the Chasseral
stops.quote: The bravest will embark on the adventure of reaching the antenna of the Chasseral via the Combe-Grède nature reserve, a strenuous climb involving ladders to reach the final destination.
